title: Maximum Average Subarray II
description: Find the maximum average value of a subarray of at least length k.
pseudocode:
1. low = min(nums), high = max(nums)
2. while high - low > 1e-5:
3.   mid = (low + high) / 2
4.   if check(mid): low = mid
5.   else: high = mid
6. return low

steps.note: Initialize binary search bounds with min and max of array [1, 12, -5, -6, 50, 3].
Binary search loop starts; mid calculation checks if average is possible.
Calculating midpoint between low and high.
Check function verifies if a subarray of length >= k exists with average >= mid.
Adjusting bounds based on whether the average is achievable.
Return the calculated maximum average value.
